blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — The Department of Health (DOH) in Eastern Visayas is calling for intensified community-wide efforts to eliminate mosquito breeding sites as dengue infections in the region more than doubled compared with last year’s record.
